purpose: Teach: むら/しづ/やめよ/資料館/遅かっ/カモ/ゴロ/栓

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、絵を描くと、色むら、出てしまうな、私。
lines.en: My brushwork's been uneven lately. Can't seem to help it.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware chuckle threaded through. Matter-of-fact observation delivered with a wry acceptance. Slight shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。しづ姉さん、戦争前、結婚した相手、覚えてる?
lines.en: Mm. Do you remember your sister Shizu? The one who got married before the war?
lines.style: Soft tug backward into memory. Conversational but distant, like she's reaching through time. Warm but uncertain — checking if the memory's still there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: タバコ、もうやめようと思っている、本気で。
lines.en: I've been thinking I should really quit smoking. I mean it this time.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Not performative — this is something he's turning over genuinely. Low and steady, like a decision being spoken aloud for the first time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 郷土資料館、孫を連れて行きたいわね、夏休み。
lines.en: I'd like to take one of the grandchildren to the local history museum next summer.
lines.style: Light, forward-looking brightness. A small plan that has already taken shape in her mind. Warm inclusion in the voice — she's already imagining their faces.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、足、遅かったな、私、散歩の時。
lines.en: My pace on walks has slowed down lately. Getting older, I suppose.
lines.style: Quiet, unsentimental observation. A fact being stated without asking for sympathy. Slow delivery — he's not rushing this acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 池のカモ、毎年、戻ってくるわね、不思議。
lines.en: The ducks come back to the pond every year. Remarkable thing, really.
lines.style: Gentle wonder. Speaking as if to herself. Quiet delight at something small and reliable returning. Slight trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、椅子でゴロ寝、増えたな、私。
lines.en: I've been napping in the chair more often these days.
lines.style: Self-amused, understated complaint. A dry observation about aging made light. Almost a joke he's letting himself enjoy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お風呂の栓、忘れずに、抜いてね、あなた。
lines.en: Don't forget to pull the plug from the bath, will you?
lines.style: Gentle domestic reminder, spoken with care. Not a demand — an affectionate instruction delivered quietly. The ease of long years together in her voice.
